required_changes: Create debug_ui/src/builtin_panels.cpp as the explicit built-in registration aggregator; register Dashboard, Control, Inspect, Runtime, Performance, Scenarios and Ink contribution families with no static-global registration.
Create debug_ui/src/panels/dashboard.cpp implementing Dashboard/RuntimeIdentity, CurrentProductState, Health, LivePerformance and RecentActivity from the existing DebugSnapshot only.

Create debug_ui/src/panels/control.cpp implementing Control/Tools, View, History and Feature. Tools owns selection-mode and eraser presentation/actions. View owns camera readback plus explicit pan/zoom drafts and Fit actions. Feature is a successor-owned Unsupported placeholder.

Create debug_ui/src/panels/features/ink.cpp implementing Control/Ink with Vector Solid, Marker Flat, Chalk Grain and Membrane, resolved brushId/revision readback, and explicit Unsupported rows for size/opacity/other parameter mutation.
Create debug_ui/src/panels/inspect.cpp implementing Inspect/Selection and Inspect/Interaction from existing product/Axiom/ARC data plus Unsupported Object and Relationship placeholders.

Create debug_ui/src/panels/runtime.cpp implementing Runtime/Document, ARC, Render, Surface, FeatureDiagnostics, Scene/Resources placeholders and AdvancedActions. Surface requests use DebugControlRouter only. Force Full Redraw is the only actionable advanced action when an AxiomDebug owner is bound; all other current Axiom command rows are visible Unsupported and do not submit.

Create debug_ui/src/panels/performance.cpp implementing LiveMetrics, InputARC and Rendering from Telemetry/ARC/Platform, Reset Rolling Metrics through DebugControlRouter when an AxiomDebug owner is bound, and explicit Unsupported MemoryCache/Trace/GPUTiming/FeatureMetrics sections with no fake toggles.
Create debug_ui/src/panels/scenarios.cpp implementing Reset Canvas, Empty Canvas and Ink Baseline as Unsupported non-mutating entries under Scenarios/Smoke.
Expand builtin_panels.hpp with explicit registration declarations for each built-in panel family and registerBuiltinPanels.

Remove the PX0-04 buildLegacyCompatibilityPanel/renderLegacy body, Transitional legacy controls contribution, legacy ##debug_tabs and legacy tool-presentation table from controller.cpp. Keep DebugController orchestration and buildImGuiPanels host-compatibility entrypoint; that entrypoint now registers the final PX0-05 built-ins.
Extend DebugUiSessionState with a bounded UI-local camera draft structure for panDeltaX/panDeltaY/zoomAnchorX/zoomAnchorY/zoomScaleDelta. Draft changes never submit until an explicit button intent.
Add read-only DebugControlRouter hasRuntimeOwner/hasAxiomDebugOwner/hasPlatformDebugOwner queries that expose binding presence only. Do not expose raw pointers or add command/business logic.

Every actionable product control must be gated by current snapshot context and owner presence, submit only through DebugControlRouter, mark ui.controlSubmittedThisFrame on actual submission, and render persistent selected/resolved state from the next snapshot rather than local widget truth.

Surface mode controls must render Platform Default/CPU Reference/GPU Default with resolved mode/generation from snapshot. Disable/show Unsupported when no PlatformDebug owner is bound or platform state lacks a usable canonical generation.
Control/View must use explicit UI-local pan/zoom inputs. Do not add Reset View/100%, do not infer a viewport-center anchor, and do not interpret legacy toolId==4107 as Pan.
Scenarios entries must not call RuntimeFacade, Router, owners, Document/Scene internals or evidence APIs.
Update workbench_state_test.cpp to exercise all six migrated workspaces, owner-unbound states, UI-local camera drafts, scenario non-mutation and expected section content.
Update control_router_test.cpp to prove the three owner-presence queries for bound/null combinations without changing existing routing semantics.

Update the Windows common structural contract so it proves the legacy transitional/tab body is gone, final panel source files exist, persistent controls read from snapshot fields, Reset View/100% and fake Trace/GPU toggles are absent, and no platform production host convergence occurred.
Update CMake to compile the new built-in/panel translation units and retain PX0PanelRegistry/PX0Workbench plus all inherited test targets.

Migrate apps/ink_playground/tests/windows_debug_ui_selection_contract_test.py away from the obsolete PX0-04 legacy-tab oracle. Replace only the Debug UI architecture assertions that require ImGui::BeginTabBar / Canvas / Selection / RuntimeFacade in controller.cpp with assertions against the final PX0-05 Control/Tools and Inspect/Selection panel sources and Router-based selection action. Preserve the separate Windows selection-pointer-path and terminal-clear/facade synchronization assertions.
